text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I just didn't have enough drive!
If only I could've... pushed harder at the end!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Maybe somewhere in my heart, I had already given up...
choice_data_list: There's no time to hang your head!
There's no time to hang your head!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Maybe somewhere in my heart, I had already given up...
choice_data_list: There's no time to hang your head!
There's no time to hang your head!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, I couldn't win! Even if the performance was good,
it doesn't mean a thing if you lose...!
choice_data_list: There are some things you can only learn from defeat!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's—?!
That line from Episode 98, 'Menace! The Return of Lardron,' spoken by Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right.
Just moping in frustration won't do any good!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll think really hard about why I lost,
and next time I'll get my revenge!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? That's right... Carrotman is cool precisely because he gets back up every single time!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Heroes never give up! Trainer, keep your eyes on me from now on! Next time, I'll definitely pull it off!
